$ python3 -m ragformation lear --help
# cwd /home/user/rag-formation
# exit 0
# at 2026-11-06T12:19:26Z

usage: ragformation lear [-h] [--backend {ollama,baseline}]
                         [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--docs-dir DOCS_DIR]
                         {doctor,docs,index,ask,chat,sessions,memory,eval,bench,demo,report}
                         ...

Answer questions about the Lear backend from evidence-backed docs, using local
Ollama models only.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,docs,index,ask,chat,sessions,memory,eval,bench,demo,report}
    doctor              probe Ollama, models, caps, streaming and judge JSON
    docs                build or verify the Lear documentation
    index               build or inspect the Lear docs index
    ask                 ask one question
    chat                interactive multi-turn session (reads questions from
                        stdin)
    sessions            list, inspect or delete sessions
    memory              scoped long-term memory
    eval                validate the golden set or run an evaluation
    bench               dummy-user load benchmark through the agent service
                        layer
    demo                guided terminal walkthrough of the real pipeline
                        (director, live, replay, examiner)
    report              summarise doctor, docs, index, every evaluation run
                        and the latest bench

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --backend {ollama,baseline}
                        ollama (default, qualifying) or baseline (hashing +
                        extractive, offline, NOT qualifying)
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   agent data directory (default data/lear)
  --docs-dir DOCS_DIR   generated Lear docs (default docs/lear_backend)
